title: Signal Desktop conversations (Flatpak)
whyItMatters: The Flatpak build keeps the same Signal conversation database and attachments inside its sandbox folder, so a native-only check will miss it.
source: Flatpak sandbox permissions: per-app config lives in ~/.var/app/<app-id>/config; Signal's Flathub id is org.signal.Signal: https://docs.flatpak.org/en/latest/sandbox-permissions.html
notes: Same sql/db.sqlite, attachments and logs as the native install, relocated into the sandbox. The database key stays in the desktop keyring.
